description: Attach a distributable file to a product, either by public URL or by uploading a local file (filePath, local MCP server only). After a purchase of the product, sequence emails can link to it with {{event.download.url}} and {{event.download.name}}.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

fileName.description: Display name for the file (e.g. guide.pdf). Used as {{event.download.name}}.

filePath.description: Local path of a file to upload and attach (PDF, ePub, ZIP, image, audio, video, or text, up to 100MB). Only available when the MCP server runs locally on this machine.

productId.description: Product ID from list_products, or your own productId for products pushed via upsert_products.

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the file to deliver. Provide url or filePath, not both.

name: attach_product_file

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `attach_product_file` MCP tool.

delivery.description: The digital delivery file record returned by Sequenzy.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

product.description: The product record returned by Sequenzy.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
